task.question: Return the tickers of the top 5 instruments by total return over calendar year 2025, in descending order. Total return is (last close in 2025 / first close in 2025) - 1.

result.question: Return the tickers of the top 5 instruments by total return over calendar year 2025, in descending order. Total return is (last close in 2025 / first close in 2025) - 1.
result.cited_sql:
WITH ranked_prices AS (
  SELECT 
    i.ticker,
    p.close,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ticker ORDER BY p.date ASC) as rn_asc,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY i.ticker ORDER BY p.date DESC) as rn_desc
  FROM prices p
  JOIN instruments i ON p.instrument_id = i.instrument_id
  WHERE p.date >= '2025-01-01' AND p.date <= '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT 
  ticker,
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_desc = 1 THEN close END) / 
  MAX(CASE WHEN rn_asc = 1 THEN close END) - 1 as total_return
FROM ranked_prices
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY total_return DESC
LIMIT 5
